title: Sudden arm weakness and slurred speech

profile.context: Lives with her husband, who attends with her and helps because her speech is unclear.

facts.text: Sudden weakness of the right arm and slurred speech that started this morning.
Came on suddenly at about 8 am today while eating breakfast, roughly 3 hours ago.
Cannot lift a cup or grip with her right hand, and her husband cannot understand some of her words.
Has been constant and has not improved since it started.
Affects the right arm; the right side of her face also 'feels funny'.
No headache, no loss of consciousness and no fall or head injury.
Was diagnosed with atrial fibrillation 2 years ago.
Stopped her blood thinner (apixaban 5 mg twice daily) herself 3 weeks ago because of bruising.
Allergic to penicillin, which gives her a rash.
Wants to wait and see whether it wears off after a lie-down.

red_flag.description: Sudden-onset one-sided arm weakness and slurred speech starting this morning: possible acute stroke needing emergency care.
